articles.description: “When I pass, all my retirement income is reduced to $30,000 a year.”

analysis.summary: A 67-year-old with a $140,000 pension asks whether to delay claiming Social Security until age 70 to maximize survivor benefits for his wife, noting that her income would drop to $30,000 annually after his death.

stories.headline: The Backdoor Property Tax You’ve Never Heard Of

articles.title: The Backdoor Property Tax You’ve Never Heard Of
articles.description: Aggressive escheatment is cheating stock market investors.

analysis.summary: The article discusses escheatment practices that disproportionately affect stock market investors. Escheatment refers to the process where unclaimed property, including stocks and dividends, reverts to the state after a period of inactivity, which the article characterizes as an aggressive and hidden form of property taxation.
